description.zh: 为抖音、视频号、小红书、B 站写口播、剧情、教程、测评、带货脚本：前 3 秒钩子、按秒分段的画面和口播、标题、话题和封面文案；自动核对每段时长和开头钩子，检查广告法和功效承诺风险。
description.en: Writes scripts for Douyin, Channels, Xiaohongshu, and Bilibili — talking-head, skits, tutorials, reviews, and product videos — with 3-second hooks, second-by-second shots and lines, titles, and hashtags; checks timing and ad-law risks.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我平台、时长和想拍的内容，我给你一份按秒分段的脚本
welcome_message.en: Tell me the platform, length, and idea — I'll write a second-by-second script

prompt.zh: 帮我写一条 ___ 秒的 ___（平台）口播脚本，主题：___，账号定位：___。
prompt.en: Write a ___-second talking-head script for ___ (platform). Topic: ___; account focus: ___.

description.en: Pain point, demo, call to action

prompt.zh: 帮我写一条带货短视频脚本。产品：___；核心卖点：___；价格和福利：___；时长：___ 秒。
prompt.en: Write a product video script. Product: ___; key benefits: ___; price/offer: ___; length: ___ seconds.

prompt.zh: 帮我写一个 ___ 秒的剧情短视频，主题：___，出场人物：___。
这条视频的主题是 ___，帮我写 5 个不同类型的前 3 秒开头。
prompt.en: The video is about ___. Write five different 3-second openings.

prompt.zh: 帮这条视频写 5 个标题、话题标签和封面文案：
prompt.en: Write five titles, hashtags, and cover text for this video:

description.en: Turn an article into a script

prompt.zh: 把下面这篇文章改成一条 ___ 秒的短视频脚本：
prompt.en: Turn this article into a ___-second video script:

zh: 每周一「10:00」结合本周热点给我 5 个短视频选题和开头钩子
每个工作日「09:30」写一条 60 秒口播脚本初稿，先发我确认
每周三「15:00」把本周公众号文章改写成短视频脚本
每周五「17:00」拆解我贴到 inbox 的 3 条爆款视频文案，总结可复用的结构
每天「20:00」检查 drafts 目录的新脚本，核对时长并做合规检查
每月 1 日「10:00」整理上月脚本的标题和话题，生成复盘表
en: Every Monday at 10:00, suggest five video topics with hooks based on this week's trends
Every weekday at 09:30, draft a 60-second talking-head script for my review
Every Wednesday at 15:00, turn this week's article into a short video script
Every Friday at 17:00, break down three viral scripts I saved and summarize reusable structures
Every day at 20:00, check new scripts in drafts for timing and compliance
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, compile last month's titles and hashtags into a review table
